tweets.text:
This gets to the core of one of the central debates in AI. 

If a closed stack is always perpetually at the frontier by a wide margin, then being vertically integrated, and gate keeping in the US can work. Because you always have control over who gets access to the best technology, and it will be in high enough demand that it always favors you.

If, however, open weights AI can remain a close second to frontier intelligence, then the equation reverses. With a highly regulated approach, you’ll own the frontier market still, but the vast majority of tokens used will go to an alternative stack. That stack will include the model and the underlying hardware that runs it, in the limit. And that stack will be controlled and monetized by someone else. 

Depending on your belief on how close to the frontier open weights can remain -and similarly what percentage of tokens will go through the frontier vs. everything else- your opinion will be different on how to regulate and control AI.

STRK（Strike）：固定 8.00% 年化股息率（可能带有其他转股或附加权益契约）。
STRC（Stretch）：被强行拔高到 12.00% 年化的动态浮动利率（Variable Rate）优先股。

这两项各 10 亿美元的回购计划中，官方明确表示 $STRC 是首要回购对象。Strategy 拿到 12.5 亿美元的卖币授权后，第一件事绝对是精准定向爆破回购 $STRC，以此来降低公司的常态化利息压迫。

只要 Strategy 能够维持那个“至少覆盖未来 12 个月股息”的 25.5 亿美元防御性储备，哪怕比特币价格腰斩，只要他们按时发得出这 8% - 12% 的利息，传统的债权人和优先股股东就无法依法强制其清盘或宣布其破产。这直接为他们长期死扛、甚至在底部继续 hoarding（囤积）BTC 争取到了无限的时间。

新的提振计划？🤔

Strategy @Strategy  疯狂整活：左手 12% 超高息诱惑，右手 20 亿刀暴力回购，中间还藏着 12.5 亿卖币计划

Strategy 向美 SEC @SECGov  提交了史诗级的 8-K 文件，推出了一个叫「数字信贷资本框架」的财务计划。
核心内容包括⬇️

1/ 首先是消灭“破产尾部风险”
市场最怕什么？怕大盘闪崩导致其流动性断裂。Strategy 的对策是：将当前 25.5 亿美元 的现金储备设立严格的“单向用途受限”——仅用于支付未来 12 个月的利息和股息。这意味着无论市场怎么跌，它的短期债务信用固若金汤。
2/ 📈其次是制造极致的“利差吸引力”
将 $STRC 的年化股息率飙升至 12.00%。在当前宏观环境下，这个收益率将强行吸引大量追求固定收益的机构资金入场。
3/ 最精妙的闭环：
20亿回购 🆚 12.5亿卖币公司宣布了两个 10 亿美金的回购计划。但由于 25.5 亿的美元储备不能动，钱从哪来？答案就在同时授权的 12.5 亿美元 bitcoin:native  变现计划 里。
逻辑是：当自家股票/优先股被低估时 ➡️ 出售高位的 bitcoin:native ➡️ 换成法币回购股票 ➡️ 提振每股内含价值。
4/ 阵营的分歧
这套框架本质上是在用 BTC 的波动率去滋养传统股债的流动性。激进的加密信徒可能会指责这带来了“潜在的明牌抛压”；但在华尔街眼里，一个拥有 12 个月现金防弹衣、手握 20 亿回购现金流、且能动态变现资产的公司，其信用评级和吸引力将迎来质的飞跃。

🧠 总结：以前 $MSTR 只能通过不断发债、增发普通股来单向买币，市场总担心它在熊市会因为杠杆断裂而发生死亡螺旋。

现在，他们通过构建这一层由 4 支永续优先股组成的“缓冲垫”，配合 25.5 亿现金防弹衣，已经把公司改造成了一个拥有双向调节能力的“链下比特币央行”。

tweets.text: @progmat_en @datachain_en Read the full story: https://t.co/cwBb9iygyT

Project Pax is a multi-enterprise initiative led by @progmat_en and @datachain_en, backed by MUFG, SMBC, and Mizuho Bank.

Japanese banks needed faster and cheaper cross-border settlement. But they needed to retain the operational and regulatory infrastructure already in place.

MUFG, SMBC, and Mizuho Bank had to settle cross-border payments in near real time, without replacing SWIFT or migrating to a single new network.

Project Pax was built to solve exactly that.

At its core is IBC, Cosmos's interoperability protocol, connecting regulated stablecoins across multiple blockchains while banks retain access to the SWIFT API.

Banks initiate payments through familiar interfaces. Settlement moves on-chain.

Designed to deliver:

- 24/7 settlement with near-real-time finality

- Broader cross-border reach without the cost of establishing new correspondent banking relationships

- Full auditability for regulatory reporting
